theme.en: AI infrastructure turns memory into strategy
theme.zh: AI基础设施让存储成为战略焦点

dek.en: New HBM capacity, inference-silicon moves, and growing optical and test demand show that the AI build-out is increasingly governed by data movement and memory supply. Policy scrutiny is following the compute wherever it can be reached remotely.
dek.zh: HBM扩产、推理芯片布局以及光互连和测试需求上升表明，AI基础设施建设正越来越受数据搬运与存储供给制约。只要算力能够被远程触达，政策审查也随之而来。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: AMD adds Taalas to its inference-silicon strategy
title.zh: AMD将Taalas纳入其推理芯片战略

summary.en: AMD is positioning Taalas as a route to bake model-specific inference more directly into its chip portfolio. The approach seeks efficiency by tailoring silicon closely to a model and deployment target, rather than relying only on broadly programmable accelerators. It is a strategic bet that diverse inference workloads will reward specialized hardware alongside GPUs.
summary.zh: AMD正将Taalas定位为把模型专用推理能力更直接融入其芯片组合的路径。这一思路通过让硅实现与模型及部署目标紧密匹配来追求效率，而不只依赖通用可编程加速器。该交易押注于多样化的推理工作负载将为GPU之外的专用硬件创造空间。

title.en: Lightmatter maps co-packaged optics around NVLink and Taiwan
title.zh: Lightmatter围绕NVLink与台湾供应链规划共封装光学

summary.en: Lightmatter outlined a co-packaged-optics path tied to Nvidia NVLink and Taiwan-based supply chains. Scale-out systems must move more data between packages without multiplying power and thermal load, making interconnect a constraint alongside compute. CPO remains difficult to manufacture and service, but its roadmap is becoming more tightly coupled to accelerator interconnects.
summary.zh: Lightmatter勾勒了与Nvidia NVLink及台湾供应链相衔接的共封装光学路径。横向扩展系统必须在不成倍增加功耗和散热负担的情况下让更多数据跨封装流动，使互连与计算同样成为约束。CPO在制造和维护上仍很困难，但其路线图正与加速器互连更紧密地绑定。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆制造

title.en: TSMC and NYCU report a 2D-transistor interface advance
title.zh: 台积电与阳明交大报告二维晶体管界面进展

summary.en: TSMC and National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University demonstrated a monolayer MoS2 transistor approach that engineers a buffer in the channel before gate-stack formation. The work targets a central obstacle for two-dimensional devices: retaining useful transistor behavior at a difficult interface. It is research rather than a production-node announcement, but it points to the materials work behind sub-1-nm device roadmaps.
summary.zh: 台积电与国立阳明交通大学展示了一种单层MoS2晶体管方法：在形成栅极堆叠之前先对沟道中的缓冲层进行工程化。该工作瞄准二维器件的核心难题，即在难以控制的界面上保持可用的晶体管特性。这仍是研究成果而非量产节点公告，但它指向了亚1nm器件路线图背后的材料工作。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: SK hynix commits 54 trillion won to Korean semiconductor plants
title.zh: SK海力士向韩国半导体工厂投入54万亿韩元

summary.en: SK hynix will invest 54 trillion won in semiconductor plants in Yongin and Cheongju, according to the report. The commitment gives the memory supplier a large manufacturing base for the AI-driven HBM and DRAM cycle rather than relying on incremental capacity additions. Its scale signals that memory makers expect tight demand to persist long enough to justify multi-site spending.
summary.zh: 报道称，SK海力士将向龙仁和清州的半导体工厂投资54万亿韩元。这笔承诺为该存储厂商在AI驱动的HBM和DRAM周期中提供了大规模制造基础，而非仅依靠渐进式扩产。其规模表明，存储厂商预计供需紧张将持续足够长时间，从而值得进行多基地投资。

title.en: Nvidia reportedly weighs less HBM for Rubin Ultra
title.zh: 报道称Nvidia正评估为Rubin Ultra减少HBM配置

summary.en: Nvidia is reportedly considering reducing HBM content in Rubin Ultra to contain cost. Any such change would show how quickly memory has become a first-order bill-of-materials and supply-chain issue for AI accelerators. The report is not a product specification, but it highlights the trade-off between bandwidth, capacity, and system economics.
summary.zh: 报道称，Nvidia正考虑减少Rubin Ultra的HBM配置以控制成本。任何此类调整都说明，存储已迅速成为AI加速器物料成本和供应链中的一级变量。该报道并非产品规格确认，但凸显了带宽、容量与系统经济性之间的权衡。

title.en: Kioxia demonstrates a PCIe Gen6 SSD above 10 million IOPS
title.zh: 铠侠展示每秒逾千万IOPS的PCIe Gen6 SSD

summary.en: Kioxia showed its GP1 PCIe Gen6 NVMe SSD operating at just over 10 million IOPS at FMS 2026. The demonstration puts storage performance in the same conversation as accelerator feeding and data-center fabric upgrades. Sustaining that result in deployed systems will depend on host interfaces, cooling, and workload behavior, not the drive alone.
summary.zh: 铠侠在FMS 2026展示了其GP1 PCIe Gen6 NVMe SSD，运行性能略高于每秒1,000万IOPS。这一演示使存储性能与加速器供数能力和数据中心网络升级进入同一讨论框架。在实际部署中能否维持该结果，还取决于主机接口、散热和工作负载行为，而不仅是驱动器本身。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Onto Innovation backlog crosses $1 billion
title.zh: Onto Innovation积压订单突破10亿美元

summary.en: Onto Innovation’s backlog has moved above $1 billion for the first time, while its advanced-nodes revenue rose 50%, according to the report. The figures connect AI-chip demand to the inspection and metrology layers required to ramp advanced manufacturing. A backlog is not booked revenue, but it offers a useful read on how long demand is reaching beyond wafer fabrication itself.
summary.zh: 报道称，Onto Innovation的积压订单首次超过10亿美元，其先进节点收入增长50%。这些数据把AI芯片需求与先进制造扩产所需的检测和量测环节联系起来。积压订单并非已确认收入，但它有助于观察需求延伸到晶圆制造之外的持续时间。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: US reviews China’s remote access to Nvidia chips
title.zh: 美国审查中国对Nvidia芯片的远程访问

summary.en: The US is reviewing China’s remote access to Nvidia chips, according to the report. The issue extends export-control enforcement beyond physical shipment: cloud or remote use can still provide access to restricted compute. The outcome could affect how providers authenticate customers, allocate capacity, and operate AI services across borders.
summary.zh: 报道称，美国正在审查中国对Nvidia芯片的远程访问。该问题将出口管制执行从实物出货延伸到云端和远程使用，因为后者同样可能提供受限算力。其结果可能影响服务商如何验证客户身份、分配容量以及跨境运营AI服务。

title.en: GAO asks Commerce to detail semiconductor R&D plans
title.zh: 美国政府问责局要求商务部细化半导体研发计划

summary.en: The Government Accountability Office urged the Commerce Department to provide more detail on its semiconductor R&D-program plans. The request puts attention on implementation rather than headline funding, including how federal research efforts will be scoped and measured. Public R&D is meant to complement manufacturing incentives, not merely duplicate them.
summary.zh: 美国政府问责局敦促商务部进一步说明其半导体研发项目计划。这一要求将关注点从资金标题转向执行细节，包括联邦研究工作的范围界定和衡量方式。公共研发环节应当补充制造激励，而非简单重复。

title.en: Challengers
title.zh: 挑战者

title.en: SK Telecom and Rebellions expand Korean AI-chip infrastructure
title.zh: SK Telecom与Rebellions扩大韩国AI芯片基础设施

summary.en: SK Telecom and Rebellions are expanding Korean AI-chip infrastructure, according to the report. The partnership represents a regional push to field domestic alternatives and integrate them into cloud and telecom environments rather than sell standalone silicon. Its practical test will be software maturity and sustained deployments against the established accelerator ecosystem.
summary.zh: 报道称，SK Telecom与Rebellions正在扩大韩国AI芯片基础设施。这一合作体现出区域性努力：不仅销售独立芯片，更要把本土替代方案整合进云和电信环境。其实际考验将是软件成熟度，以及能否在既有加速器生态面前获得持续部署。

theme.en: Hardware brings sparsity and resilience closer
theme.zh: 硬件把稀疏性与韧性推向更近处

dek.en: This week’s papers work on the data paths around neural computation: sparse die-to-die links, asynchronous control, compute-in-memory precision, and error resilience. Several contributions are measured designs, making their energy and area claims more actionable than architecture-only proposals.
dek.zh: 本周论文聚焦神经计算周边的数据路径：稀疏的裸片间互连、异步控制、存内计算精度和错误韧性。多项工作给出了实测设计，因此其能耗和面积主张比纯架构提案更具可操作性。

title.en: Quantum Computing
title.zh: 量子计算

title.en: Dynamic quantum circuits on a hybrid superconducting qubit-cavity processor
title.zh: 混合超导量子比特-腔体处理器上的动态量子电路

papers.authors: Hongbo Wu, Ling Hu, et al.

summary.en: This experiment uses mid-circuit measurement, reset, reuse, and feed-forward on a superconducting qubit-cavity processor. It reports 82% average success on a 10-bit Bernstein-Vazirani task, sub-10^-3 error in 8-bit phase estimation, and a dynamic implementation of Shor factoring 15 with over 99.8% squared statistical overlap. The result makes a concrete case for dynamic circuits as a way to trade control complexity for fewer physical resources.
summary.zh: 该实验在超导量子比特-腔体处理器上使用了线路中测量、复位、复用和前馈控制。它在10比特Bernstein-Vazirani任务上报告了82%的平均成功率，在8比特相位估计中实现低于10^-3的误差，并以超过99.8%的平方统计重叠度动态实现了对15的Shor分解。结果为动态电路提供了具体证据：可用更复杂的控制来换取更少的物理资源。

title.en: Circuits & Reliability
title.zh: 电路与可靠性

title.en: Permanent-fault analysis for asynchronous neuromorphic NoCs
title.zh: 异步神经形态片上网络的永久故障分析

papers.authors: Giuseppe Chessa, Yuyi Yang, et al.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the International Conference on Neuromorphic Systems

summary.en: The authors couple a gate-level asynchronous NoC model with an SNN simulator to trace permanent routing faults into application behavior. Localized stuck-at faults caused accuracy losses of up to 10% in navigation and 36% in a keyword-spotting case. The cross-layer result shows that spike-routing reliability can dominate even when neuron and memory blocks are sound.
summary.zh: 作者将门级异步NoC模型与SNN模拟器耦合，用于追踪永久路由故障如何传导至应用行为。局部卡死故障在导航任务中最多造成10%的准确率损失，在关键词识别案例中最多造成36%的损失。该跨层结果表明，即使神经元和存储模块正常，脉冲路由可靠性也可能成为主导因素。

title.en: Reed-Solomon decoding tailored to HBM3 error correction
title.zh: 面向HBM3纠错的Reed-Solomon解码架构

papers.authors: Jaehoon Kwon, Jeongmin Kim, et al.
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) Systems

summary.en: The paper optimizes a decoder for HBM3’s mandatory (19,17) single-symbol-error-correcting Reed-Solomon code. By replacing costly Galois-field inverse LUTs with comparison search and constant multiplications, it reports up to 97% less area and 81% higher speed in 28-nm synthesis. Compact on-memory error correction becomes more consequential as HBM stacks grow in capacity and interface width.
summary.zh: 论文针对HBM3强制采用的(19,17)单符号纠错Reed-Solomon码优化了解码器。通过以比较搜索和常数乘法替代昂贵的伽罗瓦域逆元查找表，28nm综合结果显示其面积最多降低97%，速度最多提高81%。随着HBM堆叠的容量和接口宽度提升，紧凑的存储器内纠错将愈发重要。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Temporal-sparse die-to-die communication for heterogeneous neuromorphic systems
title.zh: 面向异构神经形态系统的时域稀疏裸片间通信

papers.authors: Joshua Nardone, Rui-Jie Zhu, et al.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the International Conference on Neuromorphic Systems

summary.en: The design keeps dense ANN computation within a die but uses learnably sparse spiking layers at bandwidth-limited die boundaries. That partitioning aims to reduce inter-die traffic without asking an entire network to adopt spiking computation. System benefit will depend on the sparsity achieved after training, but it is a direct response to packaging bandwidth limits.
summary.zh: 该设计将密集ANN计算保留在裸片内部，但在带宽受限的裸片边界使用可学习稀疏的脉冲层。这样的划分旨在减少裸片间流量，而不要求整个网络采用脉冲计算。系统收益仍取决于训练后实际达到的稀疏度，但它直接回应了封装带宽限制。

title.en: SACIM: an asynchronous charge-domain CIM for CNN inference
title.zh: SACIM：用于CNN推理的异步电荷域存内计算

papers.authors: Tingran Chen, Xiaoya Wang, et al.
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems - II - Express Briefs

summary.en: SACIM combines signed-weight bit cells, a clock-free controller, and a pulse-based ADC to improve latency and parallelism in charge-domain analog CIM. Fabricated in 40 nm, the prototype reports 655.78 TOPS/W peak efficiency, 1,180.4 GOPS throughput, and 5.1 μW static power. Mapping accuracy and peripheral overhead at larger array and model sizes remain the important scaling questions.
summary.zh: SACIM结合了有符号权重位单元、无时钟控制器和脉冲式ADC，以改善电荷域模拟CIM的延迟和并行度。该40nm原型报告峰值能效655.78 TOPS/W、吞吐量1,180.4 GOPS以及5.1微瓦静态功耗。在更大阵列和模型规模下的映射精度与外围开销仍是关键扩展问题。

title.en: A 28-nm floating-point SRAM CIM macro for edge AI
title.zh: 面向边缘AI的28nm浮点SRAM存内计算宏

papers.authors: Yiyang Yuan, Zhongyi Sun, et al.

summary.en: This 192-Kb, 28-nm macro combines digital and analog CIM with an outer-product FP/INT dataflow and a residual ADC intended to cut conversion overhead. It reports 72.12 TFLOPS/W peak energy efficiency and only 0.05% ResNet-18 accuracy loss on CIFAR-100 using BF16 inputs, weights, and outputs. The work addresses the CIM challenge of gaining efficiency without abandoning floating-point-compatible accuracy.
summary.zh: 这枚192Kb、28nm宏将数字与模拟CIM结合，采用外积式FP/INT数据流和残差ADC以降低转换开销。它报告峰值能效72.12 TFLOPS/W，在CIFAR-100上使用BF16输入、权重和输出运行ResNet-18时准确率仅损失0.05%。该工作处理了CIM的一项关键矛盾：在不牺牲兼容浮点精度的前提下提升能效。
